app_store.name: Slotwise: Booking Links
app_store.subtitle: Share a link, get booked
app_store.promotional_text: New: text reminders, so fewer clients forget. Free for one calendar.
app_store.description:
Slotwise turns your calendar into a booking link.

Share the link. Clients see only the times you are free, pick one, and it lands in your calendar with a video link attached.

What you get:
- One link for every kind of meeting
- Buffers so meetings never run back to back
- Text and email reminders
- Payments at booking

Free for one calendar. Pro is $8 a month.
app_store.whats_new: Text reminders. Turn them on in Settings.
